##### load count data
##nb eliminate OPTIOX_2 since low reads
```{r}
# setup for reading in STAR counts files
counts_dir   <- paste0(fname_Fig5F_input_folder,"/counts/")  # folder where your *.out.tab files live
pattern      <- "ReadsPerGene\\.out\\.tab$"
strandedness <- "unstranded"            # choose: "unstranded" (V4), "forward" (V2), or "reverse" (V3)
# --------------------------------

col_pick <- switch(strandedness,
                   "forward"    = 2,     # column V2 in STAR file
                   "reverse"    = 3,     # column V3 in STAR file
                   "unstranded" = 4)     # column V4 in STAR file

files <- list.files(counts_dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(files) > 0)

# helper to make a nice sample name from filename (e.g., "CTCF_ctr_1" from "CTCF_ctr_1ReadsPerGene.out.tab")
sample_name_from_file <- function(fp) {
  bn <- basename(fp)
  sub("ReadsPerGene\\.out\\.tab$", "", bn)  # strip the STAR suffix
}

# read one STAR ReadsPerGene.out.tab and return a data.frame: gene_id + one sample column
read_one_counts <- function(fp) {
  # STAR puts 4 summary rows on top; real genes start from row 5
  x <- read_tsv(fp, col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE)
  x <- x[-(1:4), , drop = FALSE]
  # V1 = gene_id, V2 = stranded-forward, V3 = stranded-reverse, V4 = unstranded
  out <- x[, c(1, col_pick)]
  names(out) <- c("gene_id", sample_name_from_file(fp))
  out
}

# read and merge all samples by gene_id
counts_list <- lapply(files, read_one_counts)

counts_df <- Reduce(function(a, b) full_join(a, b, by = "gene_id"), counts_list) |>
  arrange(gene_id)
counts_df=counts_df%>%dplyr::filter(!gene_id %in% c("NANOGxt","OPTetR","MYOD1","RTTA"))#eliminate gene names not needed
gene_id=counts_df$gene_id

non_ens_genes <- counts_df$gene_id[!grepl("^ENS", counts_df$gene_id)]###genes added to the reference

# turn into a matrix with gene_id as rownames
counts_mat <- counts_df
rownames(counts_mat) <- counts_mat$gene_id
genes_mat=counts_mat$gene_id
counts_mat$gene_id <- NULL
counts_mat <- as.data.frame(counts_mat)
rownames(counts_mat)=genes_mat

samp_ID=colnames(counts_mat)

meta=read_excel(paste0(getwd(),"/Fig5F_input_folder/table.xlsx"))
#eliminate from meta line meta$sample_ID when == "OPTIOX_2
meta=meta%>%dplyr::filter(sample_ID!="OPTIOX_2")%>%dplyr::filter(sample_ID!="CIRI_4")


########this chunk it to make sure the order is the same between meta and counts, and to eliminate samples that are in one but not the other.
# --- ALIGN meta and counts by sample_ID (CRITICAL) ---
# 1) keep only samples present in counts
meta2 <- meta %>% dplyr::filter(sample_ID %in% colnames(counts_mat))
# 2) reorder meta to match counts column order
meta2 <- meta2 %>% dplyr::slice(match(colnames(counts_mat), sample_ID))
# 3) drop samples that are in counts but not in meta (match() -> NA)
keep <- !is.na(meta2$sample_ID)
counts_mat <- counts_mat[, keep, drop = FALSE]
meta2 <- meta2[keep, , drop = FALSE]
# 4) make DESeq2/RNAseqQC-friendly rownames
meta2 <- as.data.frame(meta2)
rownames(meta2) <- meta2$sample_ID
# 5) sanity check
stopifnot(identical(colnames(1counts_mat), rownames(meta2)))
# overwrite meta with aligned version for the rest of the script
meta <- meta2
rm(meta2, keep)


gene_length <- read.delim(paste0(getwd(),"/Fig5F_input_folder/gene_length.txt"))
gene_length=gene_length%>%dplyr::filter(!gene %in% c("NANOGxt","OPTetR","MYOD1","RTTA"))#eliminate gene names not needed

Rdata_filename = paste0(fname_prefix_R_QC, "_counts_un.RData")
save(counts_mat,gene_id,non_ens_genes,samp_ID,meta,gene_length,
     file = Rdata_filename)

```

####create geneInfo for QC plots
```{r}
# 1) define your organism — here human, but can switch to mouse
organism <- "human"

if (organism == "human") {
  dataset <- "hsapiens_gene_ensembl"
} else if (organism == "mouse") {
  dataset <- "mmusculus_gene_ensembl"
} else {
  stop("organism must be 'human' or 'mouse'")
}

# 2) connect to Ensembl
mart <- biomaRt::useMart("ensembl", dataset = dataset) #dataset="hsapiens_gene_ensembl" now it is made so you can switch to mouse if needed

# 3) prepare your Ensembl IDs
all_ids <- rownames(counts_mat)
is_ens <- grepl("^ENS[A-Z]*G\\d+", all_ids)
ens_ids_raw <- all_ids[is_ens]
ens_ids <- sub("\\.\\d+$", "", ens_ids_raw)   # strip version suffix if present
custom_ids <- all_ids[!is_ens]                # spike-ins / custom genes

# 4) retrieve gene annotations
bm <- biomaRt::getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "hgnc_symbol", "gene_biotype"),
  filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
  values = ens_ids,
  mart = mart
)

geneInfo <- bm %>%
  distinct(ensembl_gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  transmute(
    gene_ID   = ensembl_gene_id,
    gene_name = if_else(hgnc_symbol == "", ensembl_gene_id, hgnc_symbol),
    gene_type = gene_biotype
  )

# 5) Reattach version suffixes so they match your count rownames
if (any(ens_ids_raw != ens_ids)) {
  version_map <- data.frame(gene_ID = ens_ids, gene_ID_with_version = ens_ids_raw)
  geneInfo <- geneInfo %>%
    right_join(version_map, by = "gene_ID") %>%
    mutate(gene_ID = gene_ID_with_version) %>%
    select(-gene_ID_with_version)
}

# 6) add custom (non-Ensembl) genes
if (length(custom_ids) > 0) {
  geneInfo_custom <- tibble(
    gene_ID   = custom_ids,
    gene_name = custom_ids,
    gene_type = "custom"
  )
  geneInfo <- bind_rows(geneInfo, geneInfo_custom)
}

# 7) keep only genes present in your counts and in the same order
geneInfo <- geneInfo %>%
  filter(gene_ID %in% all_ids) %>%
  slice(match(all_ids, gene_ID))

counts_mat=counts_mat[geneInfo$gene_ID,] #keep only the genes with found information

Rdata_filename = paste0(fname_prefix_R_QC, "_counts_un.RData")
save(counts_mat,gene_id,non_ens_genes,samp_ID,meta,gene_length,geneInfo,
     file = Rdata_filename)

Rdata_filename = paste0(fname_prefix_csv_QC, "_geneInfo.csv")
write.csv(geneInfo,Rdata_filename, row.names = FALSE)
```

###make QC plots

```{r}
#stopifnot(all(rownames(counts_mat) %in% geneInfo$gene_ID))
counts_all <- geneInfo %>%
  left_join(counts_mat %>% rownames_to_column("gene_ID"), by = "gene_ID")

# matrix of just counts and duplicate to make sure not to overwrite
counts_matrix_all <- counts_mat %>% as.matrix()
# --------------------------
# 1) Total counts per sample
# --------------------------
all_counts_sum <- colSums(counts_matrix_all, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame()
colnames(all_counts_sum) <- "all_genes_sum"
all_counts_sum$sample_ID <- rownames(all_counts_sum)

all_counts_sum=all_counts_sum%>%left_join(meta,by="sample_ID")

ggplot(all_counts_sum, aes(x = name_R, y = all_genes_sum,fill = condition)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
   scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
  labs(title = "total number of counts", x = NULL, y = "reads") +
  theme_bw(12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
ggsave(filename = paste0(fname_prefix_QC_QC, "_", "all_counts_sum.pdf"),
     width = 10, height = 5)
# --------------------------
# 1) Mitocondrial reads per sample
# --------------------------

mt_genes  <- unique(counts_all$gene_name[grepl("^MT-", counts_all$gene_name)])

mt_counts_matrix <- counts_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene_name %in% mt_genes) %>%
  dplyr::select(-gene_ID, -gene_name, -gene_type) %>%
  as.matrix()

mt_sum <- if (nrow(mt_counts_matrix) > 0) {
  colSums(mt_counts_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)
} else {
  setNames(rep(0, ncol(counts_matrix_all)), colnames(counts_matrix_all))
}

mt_counts_sum <- data.frame(
  sample_ID    = names(mt_sum),
  mt_genes_sum = as.numeric(mt_sum),
  row.names    = NULL
)

meta_biotypes <- all_counts_sum %>%
  left_join(mt_counts_sum,  by = "sample_ID") %>%
  mutate(mt_percentage = 100 * mt_genes_sum / pmax(all_genes_sum, 1))

ggplot(meta_biotypes, aes(x = name_R, y = mt_percentage, fill = condition)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
  labs(title = "percentages of mitochondrial counts", x = NULL, y = "% mito reads") +
  theme_bw(12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
ggsave(filename = paste0(fname_prefix_QC_QC, "_", "mito_counts.pdf"),
     width = 10, height = 5)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 3) Percent contribution by gene biotype
# ------------------------------------------------

biotype_levels <- sort(unique(counts_all$gene_type))

# for each biotype, compute counts and convert to %
biotype_perc <- lapply(biotype_levels, function(bt) {
  m <- counts_all %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene_type == bt) %>%
    dplyr::select(-gene_ID, -gene_name, -gene_type) %>%
    as.matrix()
  sum_bt <- if (nrow(m) > 0) colSums(m, na.rm = TRUE) else rep(0, ncol(counts_matrix_all))
  tibble(sample_ID = colnames(counts_matrix_all),
         biotype   = bt,
         sum_bt    = as.numeric(sum_bt))
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  left_join(all_counts_sum, by = "sample_ID") %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * sum_bt / pmax(all_genes_sum, 1)) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_ID, biotype, percentage) %>%
  left_join(meta %>% dplyr::select(sample_ID, condition, replicate), by = "sample_ID")

# drop biotypes with 0% everywhere
nonzero_biotypes <- biotype_perc %>%
  group_by(biotype) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(percentage, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(total > 0) %>%
  pull(biotype)

biotype_perc <- biotype_perc %>% filter(biotype %in% nonzero_biotypes)

ggplot(biotype_perc, aes(x = sample_ID, y = percentage, group = biotype, color = biotype)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  labs(title = "biotypes percentage per sample", x = NULL, y = "% of reads") +
  theme_bw(12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
ggsave(filename = paste0(fname_prefix_QC_QC, "_", "biotype.pdf"),
     width = 10, height = 5)

ggplot(data=subset(biotype_perc,biotype_perc$biotype=="protein_coding"|biotype_perc$biotype=="custom"), aes(x = sample_ID, y = percentage, group = biotype, color = biotype)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  labs(title = "biotypes percentage per sample", x = NULL, y = "% of reads") +
  theme_bw(12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
ggsave(filename = paste0(fname_prefix_QC_QC, "_", "biotype_selected.pdf"),
     width = 10, height = 5)

ggplot(data=subset(biotype_perc,biotype_perc$biotype!="protein_coding"), aes(x = sample_ID, y = percentage, group = biotype, color = biotype)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  labs(title = "biotypes percentage per sample", x = NULL, y = "% of reads") +
  theme_bw(12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
ggsave(filename = paste0(fname_prefix_QC_QC, "_", "biotype_not_PT.pdf"),
     width = 10, height = 5)

Rdata_filename = paste0(fname_prefix_R_QC, "_QC.RData")
save(counts_mat,meta_biotypes,meta,geneInfo,biotype_perc,
     file = Rdata_filename)

```

###gene lenght file from GTF

```{r}
gene_length_initial=gene_length

library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
library(dplyr)

# Path to your GTF file
gtf_file <- "/Users/elisabalmaselisabalmas/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-elisa.balmas@unito.it/Shared drives/MBC-HEDGe_EB/EB002_B8_and_GERALT/AB008_bulk_muscle/Fig5F_input_folder/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.112_AB008.gtf"  # <-- update with your actual GTF path
# Import GTF as GRanges
gtf <- import(gtf_file)
rownames(counts_f)=counts_f$gene_ID
filtered_gene_ids=row.names(counts_f)

gtf_filtered <- gtf[gtf$gene_id %in% filtered_gene_ids]
gene_info_filtered <- geneInfo[geneInfo$gene_ID %in% filtered_gene_ids,]

# Extract exons
exons <- gtf_filtered[gtf_filtered$type == "exon"]

# Group exons by gene and reduce overlapping regions
exons_by_gene <- split(exons, exons$gene_id)
gene_exon_lengths <- sum(width(reduce(exons_by_gene)))  # non-overlapping exon lengths

# Make gene length table
gene_length_df <- data.frame(
  gene = filtered_gene_ids,
  length_bp = as.numeric(gene_exon_lengths[filtered_gene_ids])  # NA if gene had no exons
)

  #                        delim = "\t", escape_double = FALSE, trim_ws = TRUE) %>%
 # as.data.frame() %>%
  #mutate(length_bp = as.numeric(merged)) %>%
  #filter(!is.na(length_bp) & length_bp > 0)

gene_length=gene_length_df

# Select Ensembl IDs from geneInfo and join directly to gene_length
len_map <- geneInfo_f %>%
  select(gene_ID) %>% #ensambleID
  left_join(gene_length, by = c("gene_ID" = "gene")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(length_bp) & length_bp > 0) %>%
  distinct(gene_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Filter to genes present in count matrix and keep row order
len_map <- len_map %>%
  filter(gene_ID %in% rownames(counts_matrix_f)) %>%
  arrange(match(gene_ID, rownames(counts_matrix_f)))

# Subset count matrix
counts_for_tpm <- counts_matrix_f[len_map$gene_ID, ]
length_kb <- len_map$length_bp / 1000

# --- TPM Calculation ---
rpk <- sweep(as.matrix(counts_for_tpm), 1, length_kb, "/")  # Reads per kilobase
scaling <- colSums(rpk, na.rm = TRUE) / 1e6                 # per million scaling
counts_tpm <- sweep(rpk, 2, scaling, "/") %>% as.data.frame()
rownames(counts_tpm) <- len_map$gene_ID

# --- RPKM Calculation ---
library_sizes <- colSums(counts_for_tpm)                    # Total counts per sample
rpkm <- sweep(as.matrix(counts_for_tpm), 2, library_sizes / 1e6, "/")  # per million
rpkm <- sweep(rpkm, 1, length_kb, "/") %>% as.data.frame()             # per kb
rownames(rpkm) <- len_map$gene_ID

"dCAS9" %in% rownames(rpkm)#test you have your genes of interest

Rdata_filename = paste0(fname_prefix_R_QC, "_dds_PCA.RData")
save(deseq_counts,geneInfo_f,counts_f,selected_IDs,meta,gene_length_df,dds,PCAdata,PCA_loadings,vsd,dds,pca_res,pca_variability,counts_tpm,rpkm,rpk,
     file = Rdata_filename)
```
